diagnostics.message: Output `organization_id` is documented as "Organization id dependent on module resources" and carries a depends_on list meant to gate downstream consumers on this module's resources — the same purpose as the sibling `id` output, whose identical list includes google_logging_organization_settings.default. `organization_id` omits it, so a consumer module that receives this output (e.g., a subsequent bootstrap stage creating logging settings or sinks in the same organization) can be applied concurrently with google_logging_organization_settings.default instead of after it.
